title: NormalizedAuthorizationRequest
description: Canonical serialized form of a normalized authorization request produced by a basis-adapters adapter. This is a handoff artifact: it is not a decision, not enforcement, and not authentication.

action.description: Normalized action verb describing what the caller is attempting to do.

resource_id.description: Stable identifier for the target resource, rendered from the adapter's resource_id_template.

protocol_evidence.description: The original protocol operation, preserved verbatim for audit. Always present. Structure varies by protocol.

protocol.description: Protocol that produced this evidence. Matches the parent 'protocol' field.

method.description: Protocol method or service name, e.g. 'GET', 'ReadProperty'.

path.description: Resource path or address in protocol-native form. For REST: the request path with query string stripped. For BACnet: '{object_type}:{object_instance}:{property_identifier}'.

metadata.description: Additional protocol-specific fields. For REST: may include subject_hint and HTTP-level fields. For BACnet: includes service, object_type, object_instance, property_identifier, device_id, priority, value_present.

subject_hint.description: Unverified identity hint forwarded from the protocol layer. The enforcement boundary is responsible for authenticating and verifying this hint. Null if no hint was present.
